question: Two runners, X and Y, start from points 480 km apart and travel at constant speeds. If they move towards each other, they meet in 6 hours. If they move in the same direction, they meet in 24 hours. What is the speed of runner Y? (Assume X is the faster runner).
solution:

Distance = 480 km

Time when moving towards each other = 6 hours

Time when moving in same direction = 24 hours

X is faster

Towards each other: a + b = Distance ÷ Time
